title: Migrate golden prompts and draft prompts to JSON5
description:
Convert golden prompt tests (puppeteer/tests/golden/prompts/) and draft prompt goldens (puppeteer/tests/golden/draft_prompts/) from JSON to JSON5 format.

Uses the json5_utils infrastructure from the blunder golden migration. Update assert_golden_prompt() and draft prompt handling in golden_helpers.py to read/write .json5 files. Rename and regenerate ~18 golden files.
